visual_appeal: The hero is now the best part of the window. The bottom half is still a uniform stack of 39 px rows with outlined chips. Give rows 2-3 slightly more presence than the rest: rows that are FULL or NEARLY FULL get a 2 px state-colour wash at 8% alpha (#E6C84A at 0.08 for yellow) across the whole row, not just the 4 px left edge.

Row state chips are hollow 1 px outlines with a 12 px icon you cannot read. Make them 22 px tall and fill them with the state colour at 18% alpha (orange #E08A2E at 0.18). Drop the icon on RESTING and keep it only on NOT RESTING (warning glyph) and NEARLY FULL. Three identical orange-outline boxes in a column look like form fields.

The empty NOW PLAYING track reads as an empty text input. Give it a 1 px inner border at #3A2E22, a 25% darker trough (#120D09), and put the 'No rested XP' text inside the track, centred, at 11 px #9A8F80, instead of under it.
play_next_clarity: Each step is painted entirely in its class colour, so 'hearth to an inn' is warrior tan and 'play next' is warlock purple. Only the name should carry the class colour; the verb should be cream #F0E6D2. Right now step 2 reads as one purple label, not an instruction.

'Then Le Bankken, full in 19h' is about 11 px grey and is jammed 6 px from View details, so it reads like a button caption. Either make it a dim third disc (grey disc '3', same 13 px size as steps 1-2), or move it under the strip as its own 11 px line. Leave at least 16 px clear before the button.

The brief says the waste reason is a separate amber line, but the render still has 'Full since 1d 16h ago · more rest is wasted.' on one line. Put 'More rest is being wasted: play her now.' on its own line, 4 px below, in #E0A040 at 12 px.

Roster rows are sorted by percent (Jacques Hammer at 20% and NOT RESTING sits above Le Jedde, who fills in 8d). The timeline sorts by fill time. Pick one order for both views, or label the roster column 'sorted by rest banked' so the two orders do not look contradictory.
state_colours: The NEARLY FULL chip (#E6C84A outline, yellow text) and the gold #1 numbers and discs sit in the same hue band. Make the plan discs and the '#1 · PLAY NEXT' label a warmer bronze (#C8A060) so yellow stays reserved for the state.

The NOT RESTING row's red bar fill (#C0392B) is the same luminance as the orange fills at small size. Add a 45-degree hatch (2 px stripes at 20% black) to red fills, so the colour is not the only cue, for colour-blind users.
The timeline 'Full now' tick for Le Dette is green on a dark lane with no lane fill. Fill her lane to NOW as a 100% green pill, so the full state reads at the same weight as the other lanes.
character_identity: Card: the portrait sits on the right while every other surface puts it on the left. Mirror it: portrait left at 120 px, speech bubble to its right with the tail pointing left. That matches the hero and rows, and the name block sits under the bubble.
Card: the meta lines ('Level 11 Tauren Druid', 'Seen 23 hours ago') start about 4 px right of the name. Left-align them exactly to the name's x and give them 2 px leading.

Card: the window title 'Le Beouf' repeats the 24 px name 50 px below it. Title the window 'Character' or 'Le Beouf · Level 11 Druid' and drop the class line from the block, or keep the block and set the title to 'Rested Leveling'.
Toast and banner: 'Play Le Dette' and 'Next: Le Dette' are cream. Put the name in warlock purple #8788EE like everywhere else; the toast is where the name matters most.
default_theme: The hero background art (cave scene) passes behind the meta line and the 1.5 figure, and contrast drops on 'Level 6 Gnome Warlock'. Add a left-to-right black gradient (0.85 alpha at x=0 to 0.35 at 60% width), or limit the art to the right 40% behind the figure column.
The drawn close cross is grey #8A8A8A on dark bronze and reads as disabled. Use #D8C8A8, brightening to #FFFFFF on hover, with a 1 px bronze border.
The lighter main button is good. 'Unlink' and 'All accounts' still look the same, though one is destructive: give Unlink a muted red-brown (#5A2A20) face.
elvui_wc3_fit: The frame backdrop changes tone where the NOW PLAYING section meets the roster (around y=405 in scenes 01 and 03). The roster area reads darker and inset 15 px further than the hero block. Use one backdrop and the same inset (12 px) for all three sections.

'All accounts' and 'Unlink' button labels render with a heavy doubled outline and look blurry next to the host's 'Expanded Stats' and 'Defaults' labels. Use the host button font object (no OUTLINE flag, shadow 1,-1) at 12 px.
Options: the bottom-right Close button shows a stray blue slice over its top-right corner. The texture layering is broken; fix it, or reuse the host's ElvUI-skinned button template.

Options: sections have no vertical rhythm ('APPEARANCE' is 4 px under the subtitle, 'WINDOW AND DISPLAY' touches the description above). Use 18 px above each header and 8 px below. The host Controls page breathes; this one is crammed.
Options: the left category list is a tall empty column with one item. In the host, subcategories live there: put Appearance, Accounts, Notifications, Window, Alerts in it as anchors.
Compact tooltip: a lighter brown rectangle sits behind 'Rested Leveling / best to play first' and bleeds over rows 1-2. Remove the stray backdrop texture or clip it to the header's 1 px divider.
alerts_ux: The Esc card still has the banner's shape: same width, same red left edge, same title/body/Next structure. Make it about 70% of the banner width, drop the red edge for a 1 px top rule under the ESC MENU tag, and centre it under the menu. The 'ESC MENU' tag now floats above the frame border; put it inside, 8 px from the top.
The Esc card and placeholder icon reads as a beige rest/face glyph at 20 px, not a moon. Use the same crisp gold crescent as the default title, at 22 px.
Banner: the title says 'Cancel logout, then rest in an inn' and the next line repeats 'hearth ... then log out'. Shorten line 2 to 'Hearth to Feathermoon Stronghold, or find an inn.'

Move mode: the logout placeholder is about 430x95 with its label crammed bottom-left at 10 px and an empty right half. Size each placeholder to the real alert and centre a 13 px label 'Logout warning · drag me'.

Move mode: two stray unskinned elements are visible (a grey square near 749,585 and a bar near 375,572; the grey square also appears in the compact scene). If they are this addon's, hide them in move mode.
readability: Row meta ('Lv 6 Mage · Thunderbrew · 2d ago') and percent/ETA lines are about 11 px in the sim. The baseline screenshot used about 13 px and read better. Set secondary row text to 12 px minimum and the name to 14 px.
Timeline axis: 'Wed 25' sits beside lane labels like 'Full Fri 25 Dec'. Add the month to the axis day ('Wed 25 Nov') and use lowercase '+48h' to match '19h' everywhere.
Timeline tooltip: it covers the start of two lanes (Le Nette, Le Jedde). Anchor it to the right of the hovered point when the lane end is under 40% of the plot width.
Card rest text: 'Resting at Thunder Bluff. 0.1 of a level banked.' should be 13 px #E8DCC4. It is currently the same weight as the tidbit captions.
layout_polish: Hero: the speech bubble is squeezed between the name and the meta line and its tail touches the class badge. Give it 6 px top/bottom clearance and start it at the name's x, not portrait+8.
Hero figure column: 1.5 / LEVELS BANKED / FULL sits 20 px higher than the portrait centre. Centre the group on the portrait's vertical midline.

Card: the rest bar is 14 px tall with 90% empty track over 390 px; together with the empty band below the tidbits it wastes space. Cut the tidbit box padding to 10 px and the frame's bottom margin to 12 px.
NEXT BEST legend: the four dot counts start at different x than the row columns. Align the legend's first item to the bar column x.
delight: The speech lines carry it. Add a one-shot 300 ms gold pulse on the #1 disc when the plan changes, respecting Reduce motion.
Toast: 'double XP waiting' is the payoff. Prefix it with the moon glyph and use the green state colour at 13 px, not 11 px.

overall_notes: Real progress. The numbered plan, the class word in rows, the two-line AFTER 48H dates, the grey night bands and the reworked banner and toast all improve on round 3, and the default theme now looks like its own product. What keeps everything under 9 is execution detail, not concept. Class colour bleeds into whole instruction lines. The 'Then' step is a cramped afterthought. The waste line is still on the same line despite the brief. The Esc card is still a banner with a tag, and its moon does not read as a moon. The card portrait sits on the opposite side from every other surface. Under ElvUI there are a visible backdrop seam, a broken Close button in Options, a stray backdrop rectangle in the compact tooltip and heavy-outlined button labels. Options spacing is cramped next to the host's airy Controls page. Secondary text is smaller than in the user's own baseline screenshot. Fix those and most categories reach 9.
